notes.zh:
- **修复从悬浮球开的对话一直失败**（#57）：悬浮球面板会重新打开最近用过的对话，但这个对话在 App 里删掉后，面板还在用它，引擎重启后发消息就报“会话已存在”。现在删除对话后面板会换成新对话；万一再遇到这种情况，App 会先恢复会话再发送，不再报错
- **后台屏长时间挂机不再黑屏**（#56）：Android 13 起，后台屏一段时间没有点击操作就会被系统关掉。现在后台屏会一直保持亮着（不影响手机屏幕正常熄灭）。每次操作后台屏前都会检查，关了就自动唤醒或重建，并把原来的 App 移回去，任务继续；实在恢复不了会明确告诉模型，不再对着黑屏空转
- **后台保活页说得更清楚**（#55）：自启动、后台运行这两项系统读不到状态，不再显示容易误会的灰点，改为“需在系统设置中确认”。电池优化分“已豁免、未豁免、无法读取”。iQOO / vivo 不再把 OriginOS 误显示成 Funtouch
- 这版没有在真机上测试过
- 仅支持 arm64-v8a，Android 10 及以上；正式签名，可直接覆盖安装，也可以在 设置 → 关于 里直接更新
notes.en:
- **Fixed conversations from the floating ball always failing** (#57): the quick panel reopened a recent conversation even after it was deleted, and after an engine restart sending failed with "session already exists". Deleting a conversation now moves the panel to a new one, and if this ever happens again the app resumes the session and sends instead of failing
- **The agent screen no longer goes black after idling** (#56): since Android 13 the system turns the agent screen off when nothing taps it for a while. The agent screen now stays on (your phone's screen still turns off normally); before each action it is checked and woken or recreated with its apps moved back, so the task continues. If it can't be recovered the model gets a clear error
- **Clearer background keep-alive page** (#55): auto-start and background-running states can't be read, so they now say "check in system settings" instead of a misleading grey dot; battery optimization shows exempt / not exempt / can't read; vivo / iQOO no longer mislabel OriginOS as Funtouch
- Not yet tested on a real device
